caption: The drawing features a single large jug with a wide body, narrow neck, and a handle connecting the upper portion of the neck to the shoulder. The jug is painted in shades of beige and light brown, with blue accents highlighting the decorations and shadows. There is a subtle blue flower and bird motif partially visible on the left side of the jug. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is an inset close-up showing a rectangular section with more prominent blue linework of a floral design and the following text written in blue capital letters: "MANTELL & THOMAS / PENN YAN / 3". The overall composition is enclosed within a double border, with the jug centrally positioned and the inset placed in the top left.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
